sentences.en: When you want cooperation, share the work among many hands.
sentences.zh: 当你需要合作时，要把工作分给多人共同完成。

sentences.en: We favor the continued cooperation in counterterrorism and maintaining cybersecurity.
sentences.zh: 我们支持在反恐和维护网络安全方面继续合作。

sentences.en: Algeria needs to enhance economic and political cooperation with China.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要与中国的经济和政治合作进一步加强。

senses.zh: 合作，协作；[劳经] 协力
